A qualitative aesthetic reading — an OPEN vocabulary seeded with elegance, sublimity, kitsch. No [`AestheticQuality`](gmeow-AestheticQuality.md) hierarchy exists or ever will ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)): aesthetic traditions disagree about the inventory, and that disagreement is data.
